audit.method: All available final payloads were structurally screened. Battery candidates were shortlisted; source abstracts/methods, numerical claims, entity lists and final triples were spot-checked. No new LLM calls or gold-based scoring.
audit.selection_limitations: This is a curated demonstration set, not a representative benchmark and not an error-free annotation set. Input/result completeness does not measure precision or recall. Known limitations remain in the archived data.
